subject: Spelling 3 (#2240)
reason: The change is purely cosmetic: every hunk fixes a spelling mistake in a comment, README, test comment, or valgrind suppression description. The only source-code edit is renaming the static callback updateAppendonly to updateAppendOnly in src/config.c, with its sole call site updated in the same commit — a behaviour-preserving identifier rename. No command reply, config semantics, replication, persistence, or any runtime path changes, so there is no risky path for a scenario to reach.
